core_obligations: Show the four conditions are equivalent by comparing the characterisations of unramifiedness, monomorphy and universal injectivity.
Derive representability, separatedness and local quasi-finiteness in the case where the conditions hold.

proof_roadmap.step: Compare the monomorphism and universal-injectivity formulations.
Use the earlier criteria to close the equivalences.

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four equivalent conditions on a morphism of algebraic spaces: unramified and a monomorphism, unramified and universally injective, locally of finite type and a monomorphism, and universally injective with local finite type and formal unramifiedness; in this case the morphism is also representable, separated and locally quasi-finite. The proof compares the conditions through the characterisations of unramifiedness and universal injectivity, and derives the additional properties from them. Relating the monomorphism and universal-injectivity formulations through the earlier criteria is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 2882-2903.
